name: Sample set
notes: word (required): the word or phrase, up to 100 characters.
meaning (required): the definition, up to 500 characters.
example (optional): an example sentence, up to 1000 characters.
translation (optional): your own translation in ANY language or script, up to 500 characters.

category (optional, up to 40 characters): a group name. Known values: phrasal verbs | idioms | topic vocab | grammar | phrases, collocations | word formation. Any other text is kept as your own custom category. If blank, the Excel sheet name is used, otherwise "imported".
Save the file as UTF-8 so every language displays correctly. Lines starting with # in CSV are ignored.
